## Operator-stated north star (2026-08-14)
The completion verifier began as a SIMPLE harness-native subagent/background agent: an independent agent with read-only tool access verifying a ticket's ACs before close. It was reliable. Runaway tool calls and context-window overruns — the failure modes ALL the banking/budget/recovery machinery exists to contain — only appeared after the transition from harness-native (DSO) to harness-independent (rebar). The only intended conceptual addition since is [operator-attested], a minor qualifier. Constraint: the verifier MUST stay harness-independent, on the same machinery as the rest of rebar. Goal: step back from the emergent complexity and refocus on a relatively simple, reliable validation that the ACs described in a ticket have actually been completed.

## Investigation directions
1. Root-cause the gap: why does rebar's structured_run loop wander where harness-native agents did not? Hypotheses: harness loops provided context compaction, higher-level search, and model-tuned stopping; rebar hands the model low-level read tools with no evidence pre-assembly, so every verdict is an open-ended search under a budget.
2. Invert the architecture — deterministic evidence PREPACK: assemble the obvious evidence up front (ticket + ACs + evidence comments; file_impact diffs/blobs at HEAD; commits carrying the ticket trailer; referenced test files; direct-child ticket summaries + their manifests) into the verifier's context, then ask for a single-pass verdict with a small bounded follow-up read allowance. A human reviewer works this way; searching should be the exception, not the mechanism.
3. Validate against data: the 7-day failure mining (session artifact verifier-failure-mining.md) shows exhaustion-before-evidence dominates. Re-run the mined corpus through a prepack prototype; measure false-unmet rate and tool-call counts.
4. Success criteria: typical story/bug close verdicts in ONE model call + few follow-up reads; false-unmet ~0 on the mined corpus; banking/recovery demoted to rarely-exercised fallback and enumerated as deletion candidates; budget machinery becomes a dumb runaway backstop only.
5. Relationship to in-flight work: 8d74 (generous budgets + child term + PASS-verdict cache) is interim symptom relief and stays; this ticket aims to make that machinery mostly unnecessary. New verifier complexity must henceforth justify itself against the simple-core goal.
compiled_state.title: Simplify completion verification: evidence-prepacked single-pass verifier (harness-independent)
